provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
method: One unauthenticated HTTPS GET per series, timeout 60 s, maximum_bytes enforced, no retries, no redirect following, raw bytes written and SHA-256 bound before any parse. Parse only as (observation_date, value) with '.' as missing; no imputation, no carry across missing in the raw table.
availability_rule: An observation dated D (market close, America/New_York) is usable at the first canonical XAU D1 decision strictly after the end of day D+1 America/New_York. This one-business-day lag covers FRED's posting delay for daily market series; the lag is bound here, not inferred per row.
